scope: Fixed-state computational-value diagnostic only; no claim about complete-method quality or unconditional opportunity prevalence

capture.graph_sha256: SHA256 of exact BARR1 input file, not the canonical graph wire
capture.config: All algorithm parameters printed by config_json; explicit frozen E OPTIONS including gate_cooldown=0.5
capture.native_seconds: Actual search wall time including snapshot validation, serialization, disk I/O
capture.cpu_seconds: Process CPU time over native capture
capture.selection: Thresholds ascending; one earliest eligible unfilled slot per distinct positive epoch; no future-outcome selection; both singleton gains strictly negative

metadata.population: All four member solution mirrors plus private_inventory/private_sha256/state_sha256/rng_state/rng_sha256 and counters
metadata.private_fields_in_binary: Complete arrays, ordered queue, undo pairs, transaction flags, cost/counters, complete mt19937_64 text
metadata.graph_in_binary: Exact canonical n, integer weights, raw binary64 weights, owners, initial mask, full sorted edge list; compared byte-for-byte to replay input
metadata.archive: Raw-best solution and exact long double raw scalar; best_tick_max is separately retained
metadata.target: Exact post-scout local state on which known pair was found; fused_state when used_fusion=true
metadata.feedback_target_index: Destination population member; same both arms
metadata.pending_prefix: Normalized in snapshot copy exactly once; live E capture state remains unchanged
metadata.config_io_paths: Transport deliberately excludes events/checkpoint/trace/model/snapshot paths; replay cannot overwrite captured files

replay.ready_state_sha256: Hash after exact restore and future stream rekey, before timed action; equal across paired arms
replay.ready_non_rng_sha256: Equal to captured structural state; rekey excludes only mutable RNG states and future fused stream seed
replay.diversity_denominators: Mean over all six unordered population pairs; n and full graph integer weight sum, respectively
replay.target_after_action: Known-pair target in recover arm; frozen target in continue arm
replay.feedback_rule: Both arms apply saved fused state to same destination if target ticks >= destination ticks; recover first applies only pair and refreshes raw archive
replay.future_joint_counts: All three joint call counters are zero; known initial action is not a solver call
replay.clock: Fresh budget begins before action/skip, initial mirrors/diversity, archive and pending feedback; future cooldown/credit uses capture_elapsed + future elapsed
replay.output_transport: No trajectory disk logging; final receipt JSON encoding/writing occurs after native clock and is common result transport, not included in native360
replay.seed0: All captured member/fused/audit RNG states unchanged; future fused constructor uses captured Config.seed XOR epoch
replay.nonzero_seed: root=splitmix(captured_seed XOR splitmix(future_seed) XOR 0x7ba49f0273c51de1); member i=splitmix(root XOR (i+1)); fused=splitmix(root XOR 0xf053d); audit=splitmix(root XOR 0xa0d17); future fused seed=splitmix(root XOR 0xf07510) XOR epoch
replay.divergence: Only paired starting RNG streams are equal; causal action may change later RNG consumption and trajectories

unit_fixture.warning: Private fixed clock and synthetic graph; never performance evidence
